answer: Locks are recorded in willow, expire in ocean, and ripple lists each expiry. An adversary running 129 aliases therefore needs 154 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1228 identities would post 4545 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
